th.aboutIntro: บ้านรอดไหม? ช่วยให้ทุกบ้านพร้อมรับมือทุกภัย: รู้ว่าต้องทำอะไรเมื่อน้ำท่วม น้ำป่า พายุ แผ่นดินไหว ไฟไหม้ ไฟดับ อากาศร้อนจัด หรือฝุ่น PM2.5 เช็กของจำเป็นตามจำนวนคนในบ้าน ทำการ์ดแผนครอบครัว และมีเกมสั้น 60 วิ ให้จำง่ายกว่าอ่าน (ไม่ต้องเล่นก็ใช้ได้) ทุกคำแนะนำมีที่มา ส่วนใหญ่จากหน่วยงานรัฐไทย (ตรวจสอบเมื่อ ต.ค. 2569) บางข้อมาจากคำแนะนำของต่างประเทศ เช่น องค์การอนามัยโลก หรือ CDC สหรัฐฯ และมีป้ายบอกไว้ ถ้าสถานการณ์จริงต่างออกไป ให้เชื่อประกาศและเจ้าหน้าที่ในพื้นที่ก่อนเสมอ

en.aboutIntro: Baan Rod Mai? helps every home get ready for any disaster: what to do in a flood, flash flood, storm, earthquake, fire, power cut, heatwave or PM2.5 dust; a supplies check for your household; a family plan card; and a 60-second game that makes it easier to remember than reading (you don't have to play to use the rest). Every tip has a source, mostly Thai government agencies (checked Oct 2026); some come from international guidance such as WHO or the US CDC and are marked as such. If local announcements say otherwise, follow your local officials.
en.aboutPrivacy: No sign-up, no personal data, no cookies. Scores, your supplies-check answers and your family plan card's text stay on your device and are never sent anywhere. We only count plays and shares anonymously (Cloudflare Web Analytics is cookieless), in line with Thailand's PDPA.

en.learnIntro: Every lesson from the Baan Rod Mai? game (floods, PM2.5 dust, house fire and power cuts) and the short "what to do" guides for every hazard, including flash floods, storms, earthquakes and extreme heat, each with its source.
en.llmsSummary: Baan Rod Mai? ("Will the house survive?") is a free Thai home-preparedness app for phones, with an English toggle. It is a tool first: short "what to do" guides for nine situations (a flood coming, after a flood, flash floods and landslides, storms and lightning, earthquakes, house fire, power cuts, extreme heat, PM2.5 dust), a supplies check sized to the household, and a family plan card; the owner can put one guide on top of the start screen while it is in the news. A 60-second game is the optional way to learn it: five modes ("Before the flood", "After the water recedes", "PM2.5 dust", "House fire", "Power cut") where players tap the risks in an illustrated house and pick the safe action. Every correct action and every guide line is linked to its source: most come from Thai government agencies (often as quoted in Thai news), some from international guidance only (US CDC, Ready.gov, WHO, Tokyo Metropolitan Government), marked as under review. No sign-up, no cookies, no personal data; what people type in the supplies check and plan card stays on their device.

en.hazardLandslideDesc: For homes near hills or streams: what to know before heavy rain, the warning signs that mean leave now, and who to wait for afterwards. From agency guidance.
en.hazardLandslideH1: Flash floods and landslides: how to prepare, and the signs that mean go
en.hazardLandslideIntro: Ten short steps for before, during and after a flash flood or mudslide, each with its source; the ones still being reviewed are marked. There is no game on this yet: read it, then send it to family as a picture.
en.hazardStormTitle: Storms, wind and lightning: {n} things to do · Baan Rod Mai?
en.hazardStormDesc: How to ready the house before a storm, where to shelter in lightning, and who to call about a fallen line. From agency guidance.
en.hazardStormH1: Storms, strong wind and lightning: readying the house and staying safe
en.hazardStormIntro: Ten short steps for before, during and after a thunderstorm, each with its source. There is no game on this yet: read it, then send it to family as a picture.
en.hazardQuakeTitle: Earthquake: {n} things to do · Baan Rod Mai?
en.hazardQuakeDesc: Secure heavy things, drop, cover and hold on, never the lift, and don't rush back in. From agency guidance.
en.hazardQuakeH1: Earthquakes: readying the home, and what to do during and after
en.hazardQuakeIntro: Ten short steps for before, during and after an earthquake, including for people by the sea, each with its source; the one still being reviewed is marked. There is no game on this yet: read it, then send it to family as a picture.
en.hazardHeatTitle: Extreme heat: {n} ways to look after each other · Baan Rod Mai?
en.hazardHeatDesc: Who is at risk of heatstroke, looking after elders and children, and the signs that mean call 1669. From agency guidance.
en.hazardHeatH1: Extreme heat: keeping everyone at home safe from heatstroke
en.hazardHeatIntro: Ten short steps for before and during very hot days, and for when someone falls ill, each with its source. There is no game on this yet: read it, then send it to family as a picture.
en.kitPageTitle: How ready is your home? Check your supplies for any disaster · Baan Rod Mai?
en.kitPageDesc: Say how many people live in your home and who (small children, older people, daily medicine, pets), and get a list of supplies with amounts for your household. Every line has its source. Free, no sign-up.
en.kitPageH1: How ready is your home? Check your supplies for any disaster
en.kitPageIntro: What should your home keep for a flood, a power cut or days indoors? Press the button, answer 2 questions, and get amounts worked out for your household; tick what you have for a score and a card to share. The whole list is below.
en.kitPageList: What to keep, and the sources
en.planPageTitle: Your family plan card, free · Baan Rod Mai?
en.planPageDesc: Fill in the nearest shelter, a meeting place, who to contact, who helps whom and medicines, and get a card with the helplines. What you type stays on your device.
en.planPageH1: Family plan card: if something happens, where do we meet?
en.planPageIntro: A short plan in six boxes that everyone at home should know. Press the button to fill it in and get a card to keep on every phone; empty boxes print as lines to write on.
en.planPageList: The card's six boxes, and the sources
